svg.title: NotchHub
svg.desc: NotchHub, Swift, SwiftUI and AppKit, no Electron. A native Dynamic Island for the MacBook notch: quiet until something happens, then it springs open. A pixel fox lives in it. 16 system listeners, 5 island states, 98 frames of fox, 0 web wrappers. Diagram: the island morphing through its five states, idle, wings, compact, expanded and interactive.
svg.text: A native Dynamic Island for the MacBook
notch: quiet until something happens, then it
springs open. And a pixel fox lives in it.

g.text: Invisible. Just the notch, and a fox beside it.
Small facts tuck in beside the notch.
Opens for detail, then springs back.
Asks before NEO does anything it can’t undo.
